name: gsd-dsx
description: Specialises the GSD phase loop for data science, analytics and BI: an ANALYSIS-SPEC contract written before the data is touched, six specialist agents that fill it, and deterministic Python gates that block the loop when the statistics, causal claims, ML splits, metric definitions, data-quality profiles, chart seals, narrative wording, entrypoint fit order, decision replay, repro_lock or unauthorised findings do not hold up. Includes scored CHART-REVIEW.md via dsx-chart-audit.
